GraceDeployment.Rationale: Mark is a released, auto-updating desktop editor distributed through GitHub releases and a Homebrew tap.

MigrationProvenance.Policy: Semantic copy into GRACE 4 current state; legacy sources remain byte-for-byte as migration provenance.

Targets.Desktop: Tauri 2 desktop editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux with Vue 3 and Muya in the system WebView.
Targets.Release: Tag-triggered GitHub workflow publishes synchronized release artifacts and updater metadata; local publishing is prohibited by project protocol.
Targets.Homebrew: The xronocode/homebrew-mark tap installs the macOS application and follows the released version contract.

DeliveryShape.shape-phase-a: Electron 30 app, single main process + renderer(s), installed via Homebrew cask to /Applications/Mark.app. Ad-hoc signed. Footprint target: < 120 MB.
DeliveryShape.shape-phase-b: Tauri v2 app, Rust backend + Vue 3 WebView. Same distribution channel (Homebrew cask, same tap, same cask name `mark` — version bump triggers upgrade). Footprint target: < 30 MB.
DeliveryShape.release-cadence: v1.0 after Phase-A4. v1.x patch releases as stabilization follows. v2.0 after Phase-B4.
DeliveryShape.fork-repo: https://github.com/xronocode/mark (fork of marktext/marktext; default branch `main` mirrors upstream `develop` at time of fork; working branch `modernize`)
DeliveryShape.ci-os-matrix: macos-14 (arm64) and macos-13 (x86_64) are blocking; ubuntu-latest and windows-latest run with `continue-on-error: true`.
DeliveryShape.signing-strategy: ad-hoc only (`codesign --force --deep --sign - Mark.app`); cask postflight `xattr -cr /Applications/Mark.app` strips quarantine.

RoadmapGovernance.ProductRoadmap: The preserved development-plan phase and implementation-order records remain historical roadmap provenance.
RoadmapGovernance.ExecutionState: After migration, new implementation work is represented by approved .grace/changes/active/C-*/spec.xml and plan.xml; current graph and verification are updated as work applies.
RoadmapGovernance.HistoricalRule: Legacy phases and completed steps are provenance, not retroactive C-* bundles.
